lines.en: label mikuspring1:
scene bedroom_day
Another day means another chance to fall into an uncovered manhole and be eaten by the secret alligators in the catacombs of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 新的一天，就意味着又一次机会掉进没有井盖的下水道，被 Kumon-mi 地下墓穴里的秘密鳄鱼吃掉。

lines.en: That probably isn’t the most constructive thought I’ve had first thing in the morning lately, but at least it’s an interesting one.
lines.zh: 这大概不是我最近早上醒来时冒出过最有建设性的念头，但至少还算有趣。

lines.en: Being eaten by an animal would be a good way to go. And no one would be able to get mad at me for it since the animal would be too easy to blame.
lines.zh: 被动物吃掉会是个不错的死法。而且没人能因此对我发火，毕竟怪到动物头上太容易了。

lines.en: And also, it would give those I care the most about a fun story when they’re recollecting their youth fifty years from now to grandchildren who will have escaped the shade of my family tree.
lines.zh: 而且这样，等我所在乎的人五十年后向孙辈回忆自己的青春时，还能有个有趣的故事可讲——那些孙辈大概早就躲开了我家这棵树的荫蔽。

lines.en: I’ve been talking to myself a lot lately.
lines.zh: 我最近老是自言自语。

lines.en: I don’t mean to, but it’s a thing I keep doing and I don’t understand why.
lines.zh: 我也不是故意的，可就是一直在这么做，我也不知道为什么。

lines.en: It’s never anything interesting. Mostly just quick utterances of vague fatalisms like “I want to die” or “I fucking hate myself,” but they always make me feel off because I’m the only one around to hear them.
lines.zh: 说出来的从来都不是什么有意思的话。多半就是些含糊的宿命论，比如「我想死」或者「我他妈的恨死自己了」之类的，可每次说完我都会觉得不对劲，因为身边唯一听得到的人就是我自己。

lines.en: And I already know those things. I gain nothing from watching them fall from the horse’s mouth. I {i}am{/i} the horse. Complete with oversized penis and everything.
lines.zh: 而这些事我本来就知道了。看着它们从马嘴里掉出来，我什么也得不到。我{i}就是{/i}那匹马。连那根大得离谱的鸡巴什么的都一应俱全。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。

lines.en: I hope something interesting happens today.
lines.zh: 希望今天能发生点有意思的事。

lines.en: I hope I get to see an alligator.
lines.zh: 希望我能见着一条鳄鱼。

lines.en: My phone rings.
lines.zh: 我的手机响了。

lines.en: I press the button that bridges the gap between where I am and where I’m never meant to be.
lines.zh: 我按下那个按钮，把「我此刻所在的地方」和「我永远不该去的地方」之间的距离抹平。

lines.en: : Good friggin’ mornin’, Sensei! Or, as they say in the states, “Good friggin’ mornin’!”
lines.zh: : 早上好呀，Sensei！或者，用人家美国的说法说——「Good friggin' mornin'！」

lines.en: : Well that’s certainly a joke that doesn’t translate very well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这笑话翻译过来确实不太行。

lines.en: : I don’t get it. But there’s tons’a stuff I don’t get, so I’m willin’ to overlook that in favor of gettin’ the talk-ball rollin’!
lines.zh: : 我没听懂。不过我不懂的事多了去了，所以我打算无视这一点，先把话匣子给滚起来！

lines.en: : The...what?
lines.zh: : 把什么……？

lines.en: : Idunno, I’m just sayin’ stuff at this point. How ya been lately? Wiener still floppin’ around all floppy-like and stuff?
lines.zh: : 我也不知道，我这会儿就是随口胡说。你最近咋样啊？那根香肠还在一晃一晃地软趴趴地甩来甩去吗？

lines.en: : I...guess so?
lines.zh: : 我……应该是吧？

lines.en: : Great! Cause that means you can bring it on over here for a day of action and adventure, Miku-style!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那就说明你可以把它带过来，来一场 Miku 风格的动作与冒险之日！

lines.en: : New Miku style? Or old Miku style? Because those are very different things and require very different levels of participation on my end.
lines.zh: : 新 Miku 风格？还是旧 Miku 风格？因为这俩差别可大了，需要我投入的程度也完全不一样。

lines.en: : Mmm...old Miku style? I ain’t tryin’ to put it in my mouth today. Just wanna see your face and stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯……旧 Miku 风格吧？我今天没打算把它放进嘴里。就是想看看你的脸什么的。

lines.en: : It’s been a while, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我们好久没见了吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. Life is kind of terrible. Sorry I haven’t been keeping in touch.
lines.zh: : 是啊。日子过得有点糟。抱歉我一直没跟你们联系。

lines.en: : Nah, I get it. I’ve got too much energy for even Makoto sometimes and she’s been dealin’ with me forever. But a little dose every now and then ain’t all that bad, right?
lines.zh: : 没事，我懂。我有时候精力旺盛到连 Makoto 都受不了，她可是从小就受着我了。不过偶尔来上那么一小「剂」也不算太糟吧？

lines.en: : Oh, and before ya go misunderstandin’ that last part — that ain’t, uhh...whaddy’a call them things again? Metal...forks?
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，在你误会我刚才那句之前——那不是，呃……那个叫什么来着？金属……叉子？

lines.en: : ...Metaphors?

: Yeah! That “dose” thing ain’t a metal fork for medicine. I’ll have ya know I’m still goin’ strong without that stuff! Therapy’s been okay, though. Talkin’s still hard. And I haven’t even gotten to the tough stuff yet.
lines.zh: : 对！那个「剂」不是吃药的那种金属叉子。我可告诉你，我现在不吃那玩意儿也活得好好的！不过心理治疗倒是还行。说话还是很难。而且我连最难的那部分都还没开始讲呢。

lines.en: : Oh! And my grade’s are doin’ kinda okay now! And...let’s see...what else is goin’ on...hmm...
lines.zh: : 哦！还有我的成绩现在也还凑合了！然后……让我想想……还有什么来着……嗯……

lines.en: : Swimming! Yeah! The club’s been-
lines.zh: : 游泳！对！社团最近——

lines.en: : Are you just...going to recap me on everything that’s been happening in your life the last couple months? Right now?
lines.zh: : 你这是……打算把最近几个月你生活里发生的事全给我复述一遍？就现在？

lines.en: : Is now a bad time? Should I call back later?
lines.zh: : 现在不方便吗？要不要我待会儿再打？

lines.en: : I mean...if it’s going to be long, I can just come see you.
lines.zh: : 我是说……要是内容挺长的话，我可以直接过去见你。

lines.en: : You’re actually okay with that? Kinda figured you were gonna shoot me down.
lines.zh: : 你真的愿意？我还以为你会直接拒绝我呢。

lines.en: : We ain’t hung out in months and you ain’t been in any rush tryin’ to put an end to that. Which is perfectly fine! I know things are tough right now.
lines.zh: : 我们好几个月没一起玩了，你也没急着要结束这种状态。这完全没关系啦！我知道你现在不好过。

lines.en: : We can meet. It’s not like I’ve been avoiding you on purpose or anything. That’s just...sort of a side-effect of all of this.
lines.zh: : 我们可以见面。我又不是故意躲着你什么的。那只是……这一切的副作用吧。

lines.en: : Awesome! Can ya come to the park, then? I’m havin’ a picnic thingy with Io and Uta and I’m sure they’d be happy to see you too!
lines.zh: : 太棒了！那你能来公园吗？我和 Io、Uta 正在搞一个野餐什么的，我保证她们见到你也会很开心！

lines.en: : Three girls at once ain’t too much, is it?
lines.zh: : 一次三个女生，不算太多吧？

lines.en: : Three girls at once is actually a major fantasy of mine.
lines.zh: : 一次三个女生，说实话是我的一大幻想。

lines.en: : That a sex joke?
lines.zh: : 这是在开黄腔吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, that was a sex joke.
lines.zh: : 对，那是黄腔。

lines.en: : Heck yeah! I understand those now. Ain’t sure how well that’s gonna work in public, though. Think there are laws against that kinda thing.
lines.zh: : 太好了！这种我现在也听得懂了。不过在公共场合怕是不太好办吧。我觉得这种事应该是有法律管着的。

lines.en: : Either way! Get your butt over here ASAP! I’ll let the others know you’re comin’.
lines.zh: : 不管了！你赶紧给我滚过来！我去跟她们说你要来。

lines.en: : Sure. It’s the park near the school, right?
lines.zh: : 好。是学校附近那个公园吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, the one where Otoha’s always playin’ guitar and stuff.
lines.zh: : 对，就是 Otoha 老在那儿弹吉他的那个。

lines.en: : Is she there right now?
lines.zh: : 她现在在那儿吗？

lines.en: : Mmm...no. Don’t see her. Just some old guy with a weird coat and- oh. {i}Oh.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有。没看到她。就一个穿着怪外套的老头，还有——哦。{i}哦。{/i}

lines.en: : Ya know, maybe that public stuff is legal after all?
lines.zh: : 你说，也许在公共场合干那事其实是合法的？

lines.en: : I’m on my way. Stay away from the old guy, please.
lines.zh: : 我这就过去。离那个老头远点，拜托了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m just gonna...I’m gonna jog around the track while waitin’ for the others to show up.
lines.zh: : 好嘞，我就……我就绕着跑道慢跑，等其他人都到了再说。

lines.en: : Bye, Sensei! See ya soon!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，Sensei！待会儿见！

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and pull myself out of bed. But while I’m getting dressed, my mind strays from alligators and catacombs and lands on something brighter.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，从床上爬起来。可穿衣服的时候，我的思绪从鳄鱼和地下墓穴上飘开，落在了某个更明亮的东西上。

lines.en: Maybe Miku is precisely the type of girl who can share some of her light with me — in the good way. Not the Yasu way.
lines.zh: 也许 Miku 正是那种愿意把她的光分我一点的女孩——以好的那种方式。不是 Yasu 那种方式。

lines.en: Or the Yasu way if she thinks she’s ready. But...not in public.
lines.zh: 要是她觉得自己准备好了，Yasu 那种方式也行。不过……别在公共场合。

lines.en: There are laws against that sort of thing.
lines.zh: 这种事是有法律管着的。

lines.en: scene sky
When I make it to the park, it finally dawns on me how beautiful the weather is today.
lines.zh: 等我到了公园，我才终于意识到今天的天气有多好。

lines.en: I was so distracted on the way here by the idea that I might be biting off more than I can chew that I wound up forgetting how nice it is to be rid of the summer.
lines.zh: 来的路上我满脑子都在想自己会不会贪多嚼不烂，结果反倒忘了摆脱夏天是件多舒服的事。

lines.en: That is until a familiar scent makes me yearn for the snow.
lines.zh: 直到一股熟悉的气味让我开始怀念起雪来。

lines.en: But I forget that again when my heart is thawed by a surprisingly wholesome sight.
lines.zh: 可当我的心被一幅意外温馨的景象融化时，我又把这件事忘了。

lines.en: scene mikupark1
: Well, if it ain’t Captain Sorrow in the flesh!
lines.zh: : 哟，这不是活生生的「悲伤队长」本人嘛！

lines.en: : Hi, Sensei! Long time no see! If you’re not counting the part where Uta and I broke into your house and tried to kidnap you.
lines.zh: : 你好呀，Sensei！好久不见！如果不算我和 Uta 闯进你家、试图绑架你那一段的话。

lines.en: : Hahah...yeaaah...That’s a thing that happened, alright...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是、是啊……那确实是发生过的事，没错……

lines.en: : I can’t say I’m fond of my new nickname, but hey. To all three of you. Sorry for turning into a hermit.
lines.zh: : 我可说不上喜欢这个新外号，不过算了。你们三个都是。抱歉我变成了个隐居的怪人。

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ to apologize for, Sensei. I’d probably be go into hidin’ too if {i}my{/i} niece started sayin’ stuff that made her sound like a serial killer.
lines.zh: : 没啥好道歉的，Sensei。要是{i}我{/i}侄女开口说些听起来像连环杀手的话，我大概也会躲起来的。

lines.en: : ‘Specially cause I ain’t got a niece and that would make stuff extra scary. But I get it.
lines.zh: : 尤其是我压根没有侄女，那可就更吓人了。不过我懂的。

lines.en: : Ami is not a {i}serial killer.{/i} She’s just...kind of-
lines.zh: : Ami 不是{i}连环杀手{/i}。她只是……有点——

lines.en: scene mikupark2
: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Let’s not talk about weird nieces right now. Let’s shoot for something different instead! Like the best way to cook steak. Or weird pictures we might keep in our phones!
lines.zh: : 行行行。现在先别聊什么奇怪的侄女了。换个话题吧！比如牛排怎么做最好吃。或者我们手机里可能存着的奇怪照片！

lines.en: scene mikupark3
: {i}Io! Shh! No!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Io！嘘！别说！{/i}

lines.en: : Weird pictures? You tryin’ to confess to somethin’ right now, Io? What’choo keepin’ in there?
lines.zh: : 奇怪的照片？你这是打算坦白什么啊，Io？你里头都存了些什么？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. The same kind of stuff everybody else does. I just figured this might be a good chance to clear up any misunderstandings before our imaginations start to fester and kill us from the inside out.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。跟大家存的都差不多。我只是觉得，趁我们的想象力还没开始溃烂、从里到外把我们弄死之前，这是个消除误会的好机会。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’d rather not talk about what I keep in my phone.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我倒是不太想聊我手机里存了什么。

lines.en: scene mikupark4
: You don’t say.
lines.zh: : 看不出来啊。

lines.en: : Does everybody keep weird stuff in their phone but me? This another one of those adult things I ain’t learned about yet?
lines.zh: : 合着除了我之外每个人手机里都存着奇怪的东西？这也是我还没学会的成年人的事之一吗？

lines.en: : Everything okay, Uta? You look upset.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Uta？你看起来不太对劲。

lines.en: : I’m...uhh...confused. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我……呃……有点乱。就这样。

lines.en: : Sensei, do you maybe want to talk to Uta for a minute while Miku and I...go over...uhh...
lines.zh: : Sensei，你要不要跟 Uta 单独聊一会儿，我和 Miku 就……去那边……呃……

lines.en: scene mikupark5
: ...there?
: Now wait just one second, Io. I didn’t ask Sensei if he wanted to come all the way over here just so he could have some alone time with your roomie.
lines.zh: : 等等，Io。我把 Sensei 大老远叫过来，可不是为了让他跟你的室友独处的。

lines.en: : And I know that for sure ‘cause I got my {i}own{/i} roomie who {i}always{/i} wants alone time with Sensei and that’s just rude when we’ve got a whole group of people doin’...group stuff.
lines.zh: : 这点我可太确定了，因为{i}我自己{/i}也有个室友，{i}成天{/i}想跟 Sensei 独处，而我们一大家子正要做「集体活动」的时候这样可就太没礼貌了。

lines.en: scene mikupark6
: I agree! Group stuff it is! Talking about what we have in our phones is super personal and private anyway! What we don’t know won’t hurt us! Right, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 我同意！就搞集体活动！再说了，聊手机里存了什么这种事超级私人、超级隐私的！不知道就不受伤嘛！对吧，Sensei？！

lines.en: : Uhh...right. Exactly.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。就是这个理。

lines.en: : Well, now that all that weird stuff is outta the way, how we gonna do this? Under the table? On top of the table? I gotta know where to put the pizza.
lines.zh: : 好了，既然那些奇奇怪怪的事都过去了，咱们要怎么搞？桌子底下？还是桌子上头？我得知道披萨该放哪儿。

lines.en: scene mikupark7
: Wait, what are we talking about now?
lines.zh: : 等等，我们现在在聊什么？

lines.en: : Another misunderstanding. Please ignore everything Miku says that sounds even remotely suggestive and just continue to be your normal, cynical self.
lines.zh: : 又是一个误会。请无视 Miku 说的任何听起来稍微有点暧昧的话，继续做你那个正常又愤世嫉俗的自己就好。

lines.en: scene mikupark8
: Now {i}that{/i} is a task I can handle.
lines.zh: : {i}这个{/i}任务我倒是能胜任。

lines.en: : Well, if we’re gonna be law abidin’ citizens and all that, what {i}can{/i} we do? Cause Sensei ain’t the type to enjoy any kinda socially acceptable physical activities.
lines.zh: : 那既然我们要当守法公民什么的，我们{i}能做{/i}点什么呢？因为 Sensei 可不是那种会享受「被社会接受的体育活动」的人。

lines.en: : Boy am I glad I was just told to ignore everything even remotely suggestive.
lines.zh: : 幸好刚刚有人让我无视一切稍微有点暧昧的话。

lines.en: : Miku, why don’t you continue filling me in on everything else that’s been going on? You know, in a way that can’t possibly lead to anyone hearing anything they don’t want to hear?
lines.zh: : Miku，你不如继续跟我说说你那边还发生了些什么？就是以那种绝对不会让任何人听到自己不想听的东西的方式。

lines.en: scene mikupark9
: How the heck am I supposed to be keepin’ track of what other people wanna hear when I don’t even know what I wanna hear?! I ain’t some kinda event organizer!
lines.zh: : 我连自己想听什么都不知道，还怎么去记别人想听什么啊？！我又不是什么活动策划！

lines.en: : Heck, I didn’t even know I was supposed to bring anything to this picnic and I’m the one who kinda organized it! I clearly ain’t cut out for this!
lines.zh: : 靠，我甚至都不知道这次野餐还要带东西，而我还是那个张罗的人！我显然不是干这个的料！

lines.en: : It’s cool, Miku. Uta and I brought more than enough for all of us. Plus, we had a big breakfast earlier, so neither one of us is that hungry.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Miku。我和 Uta 带的东西够我们所有人吃了。而且我们早上吃得挺多，所以现在都不怎么饿。

lines.en: : I ate three bowls of cereal. I am not proud of myself. But I also didn’t know we were even having a picnic until we were on the way here, so...
lines.zh: : 我吃了三碗麦片。我一点也不觉得自豪。可我也是直到来的路上才知道我们要野餐，所以……

lines.en: : She probably doesn’t remember that we’re going to the movies tonight either. Uta and I both have mid-shifts, though, so we can’t stay for super long.
lines.zh: : 她大概也不记得我们今晚还要去看电影。不过我和 Uta 都是中班，所以待不了太久。

lines.en: : She’s right. Totally forgot about that until right now.
lines.zh: : 她说得对。我也是到这一刻才想起来。

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看吧？

lines.en: : I’m what most people like to call a “lost cause.”
lines.zh: : 我就是大多数人喜欢说的那种「没救了」。

lines.en: : Why put together a picnic in the first place? That’s far too passive of an activity for someone like you who seems to exist for the sole purpose of just...running around and yelling.
lines.zh: : 那你一开始为什么要搞野餐？对你这种似乎只是为了……到处跑和大喊大叫而存在的人来说，这活动也太静态了吧。

lines.en: : I gotta eat too, Sensei. All that runnin’ and screaming requires some serious fuel and my battery ain’t gonna recharge itself.
lines.zh: : 我也得吃饭啊，Sensei。跑那么多、喊那么凶，可是很耗燃料的，我的电池又不会自己充电。

lines.en: : Plus, everybody’s been lookin’ so darn sad lately that I felt like I {i}needed{/i} to do somethin’. And gettin’ you outta the house as well was a crazy bonus that even I didn’t expect.
lines.zh: : 再说，最近大家看起来都那么难过，我觉得自己{i}得{/i}做点什么。而且顺带把你从家里拽出来，这还是连我自己都没想到的意外之喜。

lines.en: scene mikupark10
: Yeah. Not gonna lie, after you gave us that speech in school, I was pretty confident you were going to go right back home and allow yourself to be chained up or something.
lines.zh: : 是啊。说实话，你在学校跟我们说完那番话之后，我还挺确信你会直接回家，然后任凭自己被锁起来什么的。

lines.en: : We were all worried about that. Which is probably why we’ve all seemed so “down” lately.
lines.zh: : 我们都很担心这个。大概这就是为什么我们最近看起来都那么「丧」。

lines.en: : Uta in particular has taken your absence really harshly. I haven’t seen her this miserable since they stopped selling the umeboshi onigiri at Lawson — the place where I work.
lines.zh: : 尤其是 Uta，你不在这件事对她打击特别大。自从 Lawson 不卖梅子饭团之后，我就没见她这么惨过——Lawson 就是我上班的地方。

lines.en: : Halloween is over, Io. You don’t have to pretend to work at Lawson anymore.
lines.zh: : 万圣节都过了，Io。你不用再假装自己在 Lawson 上班了。

lines.en: : Once a Lawson, always a Lawson. That’s what Mr. Lawson always says.
lines.zh: : 一日 Lawson，终生 Lawson。Lawson 先生一直是这么说的。

lines.en: : Miku- and you two as well, I’m {i}sorry.{/i} Okay? It’s not like I {i}wanted{/i} to make any of you upset. And while I’m flattered that you’re all this down because of me, you need to snap out of it.
lines.zh: : Miku——还有你们两个，{i}对不起{/i}。好吗？我又不是{i}故意想{/i}让你们难过的。虽然你们因为我难过成这样让我很受宠若惊，但你们得振作起来。

lines.en: : Like, look at what’s become of Miku. She’s trying to organize events now and is clearly horrible at it. Her words, not mine. But also my words. Even {i}I{/i} know everyone is supposed to bring something to a picnic.
lines.zh: : 比如，看看 Miku 都变成什么样了。她现在居然开始组织活动，而且明显烂得要命。这是她自己说的，不是我说的。但也是我说的。连{i}我{/i}都知道，去野餐每个人都有该带点东西。

lines.en: : And yet you have shown up empty-handed. Curious.
lines.zh: : 可你还是空着手来了。有意思。

lines.en: : It ain’t just that, though, Sensei. I’ve been kinda messed up too. I’ve really missed you.
lines.zh: : 可不只是这样啊，Sensei。我自己也挺糟的。我真的很想你。

lines.en: : You’ve been more than just a teacher for a long darn time. And havin’ you stuck in your house is kinda like havin’ a friend move away. So I’m tryin’ to bring some of the fun back into life.
lines.zh: : 你早就不只是个老师了。你被困在自己家里，感觉就像有个朋友搬走了。所以我在试着把生活里的乐趣找回来。

lines.en: : You have any idea how many times I’ve wanted to call ya since you disappeared? Your name in my phone’s like, the last thing I look at every night.
lines.zh: : 你知道你消失之后我有多少次想打给你吗？你在我手机里的名字，基本上就是我每天晚上最后看的东西。

lines.en: : Been dreamin’ about you too, but I don’t think I can talk about those with my other friends present.
lines.zh: : 我也一直梦到你，不过我觉得这些梦在其他朋友面前就别讲了。

lines.en: scene mikupark11
: Come to think of it, I’m pretty sure Uta has as well. Because I’ve definitely been hearing “{i}Sensei...Sensei!{/i}” in the middle of the night a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我敢肯定 Uta 也梦到过。因为我最近确实老在半夜听到「{i}Sensei……Sensei！{/i}」的喊声。

lines.en: : Hahaha! Not me! I don’t have any dreams at all! Ever!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！不是我！我从来什么梦都不做！从来都不！

lines.en: : How are you not embarrassed saying things like that out loud, Miku? I’m not even talking to Uta right now and I can already tell she’s internally screaming.
lines.zh: : 你怎么说出这种话都不害臊啊，Miku？我现在都没在跟 Uta 说话，就已经能感觉到她在内心狂叫了。

lines.en: : {i}(Fuck!){/i}
scene mikupark12
: What’s there to be embarrassed about? If somebody’s gonna shame me for lovin’ my friends, they ain’t somebody I wanna hang out with in the first place.
lines.zh: : 有什么好害臊的？要是有人因为我疼自己的朋友就来羞辱我，那这人一开始就不配跟我混在一起。

lines.en: : The thing I want the most right now is for you to get back to normal. So if I’ve gotta start organizin’ picnics to do that, I’m gonna.
lines.zh: : 我现在最想要的，就是你能回到正常状态。所以如果我得靠组织野餐来做到这一点，那我就组织。

lines.en: : Sure. Except for the part where we’ve never had a picnic before and this isn’t really normal either.
lines.zh: : 行啊。只不过我们以前从来没野餐过，而且这也算不上什么正常的事。

lines.en: : The picnic ain’t the important part, it’s bein’ together that is. So I’ve been tryin’ to spend time with everybody lately to remind ‘em all that this is just temporary.
lines.zh: : 重要的不是野餐，是大家在一起。所以我最近一直在试着跟每个人都待一待，好提醒她们这一切都只是暂时的。

lines.en: : You’re gonna get better, Sensei. And maybe it won’t ever be “normal” again if whatever ya lost was really that important to ya. But still...we’ve gotta do {i}somethin’.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你会好起来的，Sensei。也许如果你失去的东西对你真的那么重要，那一切就再也回不到「正常」了。可即便如此……我们总得{i}做点什么{/i}。

lines.en: : And that somethin’ may as well be fun.
lines.zh: : 而那件事，不妨就搞得开心点。

lines.en: scene black
I take a seat at the picnic table with all three of the girls and force myself to eat a slice of pizza despite barely having an appetite for over a month.
lines.zh: 我和三个女孩一起在野餐桌旁坐下，尽管一个多月来几乎没什么胃口，还是逼着自己吃了一块披萨。

lines.en: And while the conversation that picks up once the introductory phase of our rendezvous comes to an end is simpler, something still feels off.
lines.zh: 等这次聚会的寒暄阶段结束、对话重新热络起来时，内容变得简单了些，可我还是觉得有什么地方不对劲。

lines.en: It could very well be the fact that I just haven’t spent much time with any of these girls since before the incident, but that’s probably just wishful thinking.
lines.zh: 也许只是因为「那件事」之后我就没怎么跟这几个女孩待在一起了，不过这大概只是我一厢情愿的想法。

lines.en: It only makes sense that there are some things happening behind the scenes that I don’t know about. Miku’s living proof of that.
lines.zh: 有些事正在我看不到的地方发生，这很正常。Miku 就是活生生的证据。

lines.en: But it seems that finding out what’s going on with Uta and Io will have to wait as the two of them bid Miku and me farewell once the sun begins to set, leaving us alone once more.
lines.zh: 不过想知道 Uta 和 Io 那边到底怎么了，看来得再等等——太阳开始西沉的时候，她们俩跟我和 Miku 道了别，又只剩下我们两个人。

lines.en: scene mikupark13
For the first time in a while.
lines.zh: 这么久以来的第一次。

lines.en: : Did you know that some people do it in the butt? Crazy, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，有些人是在屁眼儿里做的？疯了吧？

lines.en: : And it’s like no time has passed at all...
lines.zh: : 感觉就像时间根本没流逝过一样……

lines.en: scene mikupark14
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 啊？你什么意思？

lines.en: : Nothing. Just narrating my thoughts again.
lines.zh: : 没什么。只是在给自己的念头配音而已。

lines.en: : You do that often?
lines.zh: : 你经常这样吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But I’ve been talking to myself a lot more than normal lately, so I guess that’s a thing.
lines.zh: : 也不算。不过我最近自言自语的次数比平常多多了，所以大概算是吧。

lines.en: : Weird. Makoto’s been doin’ that too. Figured it was just stress or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 怪了。Makoto 最近也这样。我还以为只是压力什么的。

lines.en: : It might be. There’s certainly been no shortage of that since my sadness-coma.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。自我进入那个「悲伤昏迷」以来，这东西倒是从来没缺过。

lines.en: scene mikupark15
: Wanna talk about it? I’ve learned a thing or two about therapy lately. And if that kinda thing works for somebody like me-
lines.zh: : 想聊聊吗？我最近对心理治疗也懂了那么一星半点。既然那种东西对我这种人都能起作用——

lines.en: : Maybe some other time, but not because I don’t trust you. It’s because I don’t want to put an end to this...haphazardly organized soiree meant to serve as a re-introduction to a less sorrowful reality.
lines.zh: : 改天吧，但不是因为我不信任你。而是因为我不想给这场……随随便便凑出来的、旨在把我重新介绍给一个不那么悲伤的现实的聚会画上句号。

lines.en: : I’ve got no frickin’ clue what any of that just meant, but okay. Long as you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 你说的一堆话我是一个字都没听懂，不过行吧。只要你开心就好。

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我不开心。

lines.en: scene mikupark16
: Then what the heck were all of those big words for?!
lines.zh: : 那你刚才那堆大词儿是干嘛用的？！

lines.en: : I’m just commending you for trying. It’s really nice of you to go to all this effort just to try and pick up the slack I’ve created by...semi-vanishing.
lines.zh: : 我只是在称赞你的努力。你为了补上我……半消失之后留下的空缺，费了这么大劲，真的很好。

lines.en: scene mikupark17
: Oh...yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦……是啊。

lines.en: : It’s been hard. All of this stuff. And I ain’t just sayin’ that cause I’ve had to go back to usin’ my own fingers.
lines.zh: : 这段时间很不好过。所有这一切。而且我这么说可不只是因为我不得不重新用回自己的手指。

lines.en: : The thing is...I really like you. Lots of us do. But since I haven’t been able to {i}get{/i} to you, I’ve just been tryin’ to pick everybody else up instead.
lines.zh: : 问题是……我真的很喜欢你。我们很多人都喜欢你。可既然我一直{i}够不着{/i}你，我就只能转而去把其他人一个个扶起来。

lines.en: : Makoto’s...fine, I think? Which is weird. But she also just had some crazy trauma with her dad recently that might’a helped her deal with stuff like people vanishin’ a little better, though.
lines.zh: : Makoto 嘛……我觉得还算好吧？说起来挺怪的。不过她最近刚跟她爸经历了那场可怕的事，也许这反倒让她更能应付「有人消失」这种事了。

lines.en: : Sana’s been weird, though. Io’s been worse than normal. Uta’s cryin’ a lot. Futaba seems stressed. Kirin’s kinda...I don’t know. Let’s just say she’s weird too. But Ayane’s got it the worst.
lines.zh: : Sana 最近有点怪。Io 比平常更糟。Uta 老是在哭。Futaba 看起来压力很大。Kirin 嘛……我也不知道。就当她也挺怪的吧。但要说最惨的，还是 Ayane。

lines.en: : She cries in the shower after swim club so nobody will notice, but I do. I {i}always{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 游泳社活动结束后，她会在淋浴间里哭，好让别人发现不了——可我发现了。我{i}每次都{/i}发现。

lines.en: : You...watch Ayane shower often?
lines.zh: : 你……经常看 Ayane 洗澡？

lines.en: scene mikupark18
: Body goals, Sensei. Body goals.
lines.zh: : 身材标杆啊，Sensei。身材标杆。

lines.en: : Ayane’s got the kinda figure girls like me can only dream of. Had no idea I’d stumble upon her havin’ a secret breakdown in there. But she won’t even talk to me about it since we ain’t close.
lines.zh: : Ayane 那种身材，是我这样的女生做梦都不敢想的。我完全没想到会撞见她在里面偷偷崩溃。可她连跟我说都不肯，因为我们不算亲近。

lines.en: : Ayane doesn’t like talking about things like that with {i}anyone.{/i} She’s like me. More of a...{i}bottle it up{/i} type of person.
lines.zh: : Ayane 不喜欢跟{i}任何人{/i}聊这种事。她跟我一样。属于那种……{i}把什么都憋在心里{/i}的人。

lines.en: scene mikupark19
: I get it. You know I do. But we’re {i}all{/i} gonna wind up miserable if we keep doin’ that to ourselves. Which is why I just want us all to...get back to where we were at the start of the year.
lines.zh: : 我懂。你知道我懂的。可要是我们一直这样对自己，最后{i}所有人{/i}都会变得很惨。所以我才想让大家……回到年初时候的样子。

lines.en: : Back when...
lines.zh: : 回到那时候……

lines.en: scene mikupark20
: When...
lines.zh: : 那时候……

lines.en: : Wait...what? Weren’t you absent at the start of the year? How does that...nah, I’ve gotta be.....
lines.zh: : 等等……什么？年初的时候你不是还缺席着吗？那怎么……算了，我肯定是……

lines.en: scene mikupark21
: A-Anyway! If things are ever gonna be fun again, me and {i}you{/i} are-
lines.zh: : 总、总之！要是日子还想再变回有趣的样子，我和{i}你{/i}——

lines.en: : You and I.
lines.zh: : 你和我。

lines.en: : You and {i}I{/i} are gonna have to cross this...bridge or somethin’ together! Which means continuin’ to explore and continuin’ to enjoy each other’s company! Both sexually and {i}not{/i} sexually!
lines.zh: : 你和{i}我{/i}得一起跨过这座……桥什么的！也就是说要继续探索、继续享受彼此的陪伴！性方面的和{i}非{/i}性方面的都是！

lines.en: : And...which one of those things do you want most right now, Miku?
lines.zh: : 那么……现在你最想要的是哪一种，Miku？

lines.en: : Both! I am very conflicted and very excited to see you again!
lines.zh: : 两个都要！我现在特别矛盾，又特别兴奋能再见到你！

lines.en: scene mikupark22
: Which means...
lines.zh: : 也就是说……

lines.en: : Which means?
lines.zh: : 也就是说？

lines.en: : Which means there is only {i}one{/i} place the two of us can go...to kill both birds with a rock.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我们能去的地方只有{i}一个{/i}……能用一块石头把两只鸟都砸下来。

lines.en: : Not how that phrase goes, Miku.
lines.zh: : 那个成语不是这么说的，Miku。

lines.en: : Things have changed here on the outside while you’ve been gone, Sensei. You don’t know how we talk anymore.
lines.zh: : 你不在的这段时间，外面的世界变了，Sensei。你现在已经不懂我们怎么讲话了。

lines.en: : Miku, just tell me where we’re going.
lines.zh: : Miku，直接告诉我我们要去哪儿。

lines.en: : To the {i}promised land,{/i} Sensei.
lines.zh: : 去{i}应许之地{/i}，Sensei。
